agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Provider-free test collection must derive every package and fixture root from the exact task-owned repository or explicit input and must never depend on the ambient user home.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first sealed provider-free import consulted the ambient home for a package location and failed before any native process.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The provider-free runner removed the ambient dependency and collection rejected the import before process, provider or canonical activity.

correction.action: Bind the bootstrap to the exact task-owned root and rerun sealed provider-free collection.
correction.prevention_control: Provider-free tests cover the sealed environment and reject ambient-home dependency before native execution.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records and corrects the ambient-home dependency in provider-free test bootstrap.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The controller's static scope guard must reject real forbidden surfaces without self-matching audit-only literals.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first guard matched credential and future-attempt names that appeared only as literal audit constants, while no such surface was opened.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Focused static tests failed before native execution and inspection showed the matches originated inside the guard's own constant list.

correction.action: Compose audit-only names from closed fragments and keep the forbidden literal absent from executable source.
correction.prevention_control: Focused tests distinguish an actual forbidden token from the guard's own audit vocabulary.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: preserves the static-guard self-match and its source-owned audit-token correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The controller must import its repository modules under both direct-path and module-shaped execution from the exact checkout.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first direct-path check could not import repository modules even though module-shaped execution worked.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The deterministic CLI gate failed before native execution and the same source passed when invoked as a module.

correction.action: Insert the resolved repository root for direct entry-point execution and rerun both invocation shapes.
correction.prevention_control: Focused controller tests exercise direct-path and module execution before any process admission.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the direct-entry import defect and its exact repository-root binding.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every named latch checkpoint must be published only by the exclusive clockwork writer over all ten canonical surfaces.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: One intermediate checkpoint wrote the latch directly and created canonical drift before native execution.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The clockwork predecessor and canonical-source comparison rejected the drift before process or provider dispatch.

correction.action: Reject the direct draft and restore all ten canonical surfaces through the clockwork's byte-recoverable predecessor before continuing.
correction.prevention_control: The governance owner guard and source-byte comparison reject direct latch drift before any subsequent checkpoint or dispatch.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: preserves the direct-latch ownership breach and clockwork-owned byte recovery.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every Git object displayed in checkpoint prose must be injected from the same machine resolver as the source binding and must never be manually completed.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first pre-verifier prose contained a 40-character-looking expansion that did not equal the resolver's full object while the machine source binding itself was correct.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Full checkpoint readback compared the prose with git rev-parse before verifier acceptance and preserved the rejected checkpoint.

correction.action: Publish a fresh clockwork checkpoint with the exact resolver-returned full object injected into both binding and prose.
correction.prevention_control: Checkpoint builders reuse one resolver value for every source display and validation rejects any conflicting object-like token.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: preserves the conflicting checkpoint Git prose and its machine-injected full-object correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Clockwork command manifests must use the exact admitted Python module entry point and may not introduce a direct Git executable.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first local manifest named Git directly and was rejected by the closed command grammar before publication.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Manifest validation stopped before command execution, canonical mutation or provider activity.

correction.action: Replace the direct executable with the exact Python -m clockwork command and rerun validation.
correction.prevention_control: The clockwork command grammar admits only its exact module entry point and rejects all other executables before publication.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected clockwork executable and the closed Python-module command grammar.

correction.prevention_control: No further native process is admitted until deterministic package-source subcoordinates pass and a separate exact checkpoint is published.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: preserves the one provider-disabled preset-validation failure and its no-retry subcoordinate successor.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The controller must resolve the same exact native worker root from the primary checkout and any direct isolated review worktree.
